dct_description_sm:
Depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 12-Special Study Areas identify lands that require further analysis, planning studies, or assessment before future land use decisions or development can proceed. These areas are subject to additional investigation to ensure that growth and development are coordinated, sustainable, and supported by appropriate infrastructure and policy frameworks.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
